faq_heading: Metrotown condos and townhomes: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for condos and townhomes in Metrotown. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Metrotown, Burnaby: 341 condos and townhomes listed at the end of September 2026 and 35 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 10%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. By listings that is number 2 of 35 Burnaby communities for condos and townhomes.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Burnaby total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Listings of condos and townhomes in Metrotown fell from 371 in June to 341 in September (−8.1%), and 191 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 25.6% of Burnaby’s 1,333 condos and townhomes listed.
Condos and townhomes or houses in Metrotown?
Metrotown also had 14 houses listed and 7 sold in September, against 341 condos and townhomes listed. The Metrotown houses page has those figures.

blocks.text: Metrotown home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

410 condos sold in Metrotown with a median price of $690,000 (the middle half sold between $580,000 and $815,750), taking a median of 31 days to sell at 97.0% of the last list price; 8% sold above list. They had a median $909 per square foot, a median year built of 2017 and a median strata fee of $426 a month. 31 townhomes sold in Metrotown with a median price of $979,000 (the middle half sold between $734,000 and $1,142,500), taking a median of 39 days to sell at 97.2% of the last list price; 3% sold above list. They had a median $800 per square foot, a median year built of 2016 and a median strata fee of $369 a month.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Metrotown?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 341 condos and townhomes listed in Metrotown. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Metrotown a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?
faq.a: In September 2026, condos and townhomes in Metrotown had a sales ratio of 10%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in Metrotown from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 191 condos and townhomes sold in Metrotown over those 4 months, out of 750 in all of Burnaby.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.

faq.q: What did condos in Metrotown sell for?
faq.a: 410 condos sold in Metrotown between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $690,000.

faq.q: How long do condos take to sell in Metrotown?
faq.a: The median was 31 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.0% of the last list price (8% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
